card.name: Linking words before HIV drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as taking, to, of, with, or right before an upcoming antiretroviral drug name (dolutegravir, efavirenz, CABENUVA, rilpivirine) in HIV drug label text.

modes.label: Patients taking/treated with
modes.description: Verbs or prepositions after 'patients' that lead into a named HIV drug.

modes.label: Of/to before a drug
modes.description: 'of' or 'to' linking a dose, component or switch to a specific drug name.
modes.example: for those switching<< to>> dolutegravir plus ril

card.writes: It pushes up injection-related words like inject and Injection and harm, which fits injectable drug contexts.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before an HIV drug name is about to appear.
